steps.what: List stored amounts by denomination
Arrange monies received in cash boxes by denomination
Fill coin dispensers from the arranged cash
Sign the cash arrangement
File the signed cash arrangement
outputs: filed copy of signed cash arrangement v1

tasks.design: A job lists stored amounts by denomination in {BANK}. The teller arranges the monies received in the cash boxes and fills the coin dispensers. A later job files the signed note in {DOCS}. The handling is unchanged.
tasks.previous_blocker: Denominations were written on a slip before the sort.
tasks.enabler_now: Denomination and amount are already stored.
tasks.still_hard: The cash is still arranged by hand.
tasks.human_edge: The teller decides the box is ready.
tasks.altitude: The teller spends the week on the boxes, not on listing denominations.

reach.task: Use only the arrangement the teller signed

evidence.claim: The executive digest says a person keeps persuading and the payment release.

assumptions: Denomination, amount, and box identifier are stored on the cash record. The cash record produces them. A blank amount stays blank and is not treated as zero.
Native configuration of the cash record is used before any custom code.
Only the version the teller signed is filed or sent.
unknowns: Who else must see the signed note.
research_questions: How often the required field is blank.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining work is still the teller arranging monies by denomination.

incremental.description: Refresh denomination and amount when the cash layout changes, and drop a note the teller has not signed.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes many denomination amounts are blank. The high end assumes denomination and amount are stored. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: List mortgage, loan, and utility payments due
Receive mortgage, loan, and public utility payments
Verifying payment dates and amounts due
Sign the payment receipt
File the signed payment receipt
outputs: filed copy of signed payment receipt v1

tasks.design: A job lists mortgage, loan, and public utility payments in {BANK} that are due on the stored payment date. The teller receives the payment and verifies the date and the amount due. A later job files the signed receipt in {DOCS}. It does not score the loan.
tasks.previous_blocker: Due amounts were read from a paper bill.
tasks.enabler_now: Bill identifier, due date, and amount due are already stored.
tasks.still_hard: The payment is still received at the window.
tasks.altitude: The teller spends the week on the payment, not on finding the due date.

reach.task: Pay only the amount the teller verified

evidence.claim: The executive digest says a person keeps persuading and the payment release.
Digest [S17] says worker monitoring and creditworthiness of natural persons are high-risk. This design does not score a customer.

assumptions: Bill identifier, kind, due date, and amount due are stored on the billing record. The billing record produces them. A payment is due on the stored payment date. A blank date is shown as not due. A blank amount stays blank and is not collected as zero.
Native configuration of the billing record is used before any custom code.
Only the version the teller signed is filed or sent.
Receiving the payment is not a credit score.
unknowns: Who else must see the signed note.
research_questions: How often the required field is blank.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining check is still the teller verifying payment dates and amounts due.

incremental.description: Refresh bill identifier, due date, and amount due when the billing layout changes, and drop a receipt the teller has not signed.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes many due dates are blank. The high end assumes bill identifier, due date, and amount due are stored. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: List computerized information with no customer score
Explain and promote travelers' checks and savings bonds
Sell money orders and cashier's checks in person
Do not tailor recommendations for products or services
Sign the product conversation
File the signed product conversation
outputs: filed copy of signed product conversation v1

tasks.design: A job lists computerized information in {CRM} and writes no customer score. The teller explains, promotes, and sells travelers' checks, savings bonds, money orders, and cashier's checks. A later job files the signed note in {DOCS}. It does not tailor a recommendation by a rule.
tasks.previous_blocker: Product facts were gathered before the conversation.
tasks.enabler_now: Product identifier and price are already stored.
tasks.still_hard: The conversation stays with the teller.
tasks.human_edge: The teller decides what to offer.
tasks.altitude: The teller spends the week in the conversation, not on listing facts.

reach.task: Buy only what the teller explained

evidence.claim: The executive digest says a person keeps persuading and the payment release.
Digest [S17] says worker monitoring and creditworthiness of natural persons are high-risk. This design does not score a customer.

assumptions: Product identifier, price, and customer identifier are stored on the product record. The product record produces them. A blank price stays blank and is not offered as zero. The list is not a score.
Native configuration of the product record is used before any custom code.
Only the version the teller signed is filed or sent.
The teller does not tailor a product score.
unknowns: Who else must see the signed note.
research_questions: How often the required field is blank.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining sale is still the teller selling the products.

incremental.description: Refresh product identifier and price when the product layout changes, and drop a note the teller has not signed.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes many prices are blank. The high end assumes product identifier and price are stored. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: List the armored car deposit against the stored slip
Count and verify the armored car deposits
Decide the total before it is posted
Sign the armored car total
Post only the signed armored car deposits
outputs: filed copy of signed armored total v1

tasks.design: A job lists the armored car deposit in {BANK} against the stored slip. The teller counts and verifies the deposits and decides the total. A later job posts only the signed deposits. It does not post an unsigned total.
tasks.previous_blocker: The slip was compared by eye before posting.
tasks.enabler_now: Deposit identifier and slip total are already stored.
tasks.still_hard: The count is still done by the teller.
tasks.human_edge: The teller decides the total to post.
tasks.altitude: The teller spends the week on the count, not on listing the slip.

reach.task: Post only the total the teller signed

evidence.claim: The executive digest says a person keeps persuading and the payment release.
The executive digest says a match is posted only on an exact amount, and any miss stops with a person.

assumptions: Deposit identifier, slip total, and counted total are stored on the deposit record. The deposit record produces the slip total. A blank total stays blank and is not posted as zero.
Native configuration of the deposit record is used before any custom code.
Only the version the teller signed is filed or sent.
The post is the signed total and no other amount.
unknowns: Who else must see the signed note.
research_questions: How often the required field is blank.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining count is still the teller counting and verifying the deposits.

incremental.description: Refresh deposit identifier and slip total when the deposit layout changes, and drop a posting the teller has not signed.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes many slip totals are blank. The high end assumes deposit identifier and slip total are stored. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The teller spends the week at the window, on the cash, and on the signed amount. A stored total, a fee from a stored rule, and filing that signature can move. The teller still counts the cash, checks the signature, and releases the payment.
reach: A customer receives only the amount the teller signed.
A colleague posts only the deposit the teller signed.
skills_to_grow: Reject a payout that the teller has not signed.
Reject a fee that does not match the stored rule.
Reject a balance that treats a blank amount as zero.
role.ambitious_version: A signed payout or statement can go out the same day, and the teller still owns the cash.
